metrics.note: Retrained on the full ENCODE pancreas peak set: 10 ATAC and 14 H3K27ac released narrowPeak files, up from 4 and 4, giving 1,376,493 accessible H3K27ac-marked regions against 470,874 before. Trained on 540,199 rows (320,000 actives), which is eight times the previous training set, using index-encoded sequence with per-batch one-hot so the data need not fit on the GPU. Fixed held-out test is all 54,103 rows on chr8 and chr9 of the enriched dataset, and the previously deployed model was re-scored on that same test for comparability: 0.8300 to 0.8375, +0.0074. That gain is about 1.2 times the 0.0063 non-monotonicity of the curve itself and therefore is NOT established as an improvement; the curve remains non-monotone and the signal head is marginally worse. The model is retained because it rests on far more biological replication, not because the benchmark moved. results/enhancer_maxdata.json
metrics.training_data: ENCODE pancreas ATAC and H3K27ac, all released GRCh38 narrowPeak files (10 + 14), 320,000 actives of 1,376,493 available
